content: BAMBOO SHEETS - Crafted from bamboo, these all-natural luxury sheets provide a much longer life span than bamboo blend sheets, microfiber, or cotton sheets. Bamboo sheets have a history of retaining their softness for years of cozy comfort.

SUPER COOLING BAMBOO SHEETS - Bamboo sheets will keep you comfortable and cool all night long. Bamboo sheets are great if you’re a hot sleeper, suffer from night sweats, or have hot flashes because of their breathability.

DEEP POCKET SHEETS - Many mattresses are quite deep these days and those mattresses require sheets with deep pockets to match. Bamboo sheets are a perfect complement for these mattresses due to the fabric’s flexibility. Our bamboo sheets fit mattresses up to 16 inches deep and still fit great on mattresses less than 16 inches.

SUPER SOFT & LIGHTWEIGHT - These luxury bamboo bed sheets are light, breathable, and silky soft. Soft and cooling bamboo sheets provide a luxurious night’s sleep. Instead of being a bamboo blend with heavy fabrics such as cotton, microfiber, or even worse polyester these soft bamboo sheets are made from high-quality natural bamboo fibers.

MOISTURE WICKING SHEETS - Bamboo sheets are great moisture-wicking sheets because bamboo fabrics are hygroscopic, meaning they absorb moisture and move it away from your body. This quality lends to the comfort and breathability of bamboo sheets. The moisture-wicking properties of these soft bamboo sheets deliver a dry, fresh, and friendly night’s sleep.

aigc_info.long_text: The CGK Bamboo Cooling Sheet Set offers a premium sleep experience crafted entirely from natural bamboo fibers. These sheets provide a soft, silky texture that stays smooth and comfortable for years, perfectly suited for those who value durability alongside comfort. Designed to enhance breathability and coolness, the sheets help regulate temperature, making them ideal for hot sleepers or anyone prone to night sweats. The moisture-wicking properties of bamboo fabric move moisture away from the body, ensuring a dry, fresh night's rest. With deep pockets designed to fit mattresses up to 16 inches, this set also accommodates many modern bed sizes while ensuring a snug fit. Available in king size and in a rich navy blue color, this sheet set combines practicality with elegant simplicity. Easy to care for, the sheets are machine washable, offering convenience without compromising quality. This bamboo sheet set is an excellent choice for anyone seeking a cool, soft, and breathable bedding option that lasts.
aigc_info.faq:
Q:What material are the CGK Bamboo Cooling Sheets made from?
A:They are made from 100% rayon derived from natural bamboo fibers.

Q:What mattress depth do these bamboo sheets fit?
A:They fit mattresses up to 16 inches deep.

Q:Are these bamboo sheets machine washable?
A:Yes, the sheets are machine washable for easy care.

Q:What sizes and colors are available for this bamboo sheet set?
A:The set is available in king size and comes in a navy blue color.

Q:Do the sheets help with overheating or night sweats?
A:Yes, the breathable and moisture-wicking bamboo fabric helps keep sleepers cool and dry.
